definition_text: the process of using person identification data in electronic form uniquely representing either a natural or legal person, or a natural person representing a legal person
full_text: ‘electronic identification’ means the process of using person identification data in electronic form uniquely representing either a natural or legal person, or a natural person representing a legal person;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a material and/or immaterial unit containing person identification data and which is used for authentication for an online service
full_text: ‘electronic identification means’ means a material and/or immaterial unit containing person identification data and which is used for authentication for an online service;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a set of data enabling the identity of a natural or legal person, or a natural person representing a legal person to be established
full_text: ‘person identification data’ means a set of data enabling the identity of a natural or legal person, or a natural person representing a legal person to be established;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a system for electronic identification under which electronic identification means are issued to natural or legal persons, or natural persons representing legal persons
full_text: ‘electronic identification scheme’ means a system for electronic identification under which electronic identification means are issued to natural or legal persons, or natural persons representing legal persons;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic process that enables the electronic identification of a natural or legal person, or the origin and integrity of data in electronic form to be confirmed
full_text: ‘authentication’ means an electronic process that enables the electronic identification of a natural or legal person, or the origin and integrity of data in electronic form to be confirmed;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a natural or legal person that relies upon an electronic identification or a trust service
full_text: ‘relying party’ means a natural or legal person that relies upon an electronic identification or a trust service;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a state, regional or local authority, a body governed by public law or an association formed by one or several such authorities or one or several such bodies governed by public law, or a private entity mandated by at least one of those authorities, bodies or associations to provide public services, when acting under such a mandate
full_text: ‘public sector body’ means a state, regional or local authority, a body governed by public law or an association formed by one or several such authorities or one or several such bodies governed by public law, or a private entity mandated by at least one of those authorities, bodies or associations to provide public services, when acting under such a mandate;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a body defined in point (4) of Article 2(1) of Directive 2014/24/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council (1)
full_text: ‘body governed by public law’ means a body defined in point (4) of Article 2(1) of Directive 2014/24/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council (1);
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a natural person who creates an electronic signature
full_text: ‘signatory’ means a natural person who creates an electronic signature;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: data in electronic form which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form and which is used by the signatory to sign
full_text: ‘electronic signature’ means data in electronic form which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form and which is used by the signatory to sign;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic signature which meets the requirements set out in Article 26
full_text: ‘advanced electronic signature’ means an electronic signature which meets the requirements set out in Article 26;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an advanced electronic signature that is created by a qualified electronic signature creation device, and which is based on a qualified certificate for electronic signatures
full_text: ‘qualified electronic signature’ means an advanced electronic signature that is created by a qualified electronic signature creation device, and which is based on a qualified certificate for electronic signatures;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: unique data which is used by the signatory to create an electronic signature
full_text: ‘electronic signature creation data’ means unique data which is used by the signatory to create an electronic signature;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic attestation which links electronic signature validation data to a natural person and confirms at least the name or the pseudonym of that person
full_text: ‘certificate for electronic signature’ means an electronic attestation which links electronic signature validation data to a natural person and confirms at least the name or the pseudonym of that person;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a certificate for electronic signatures, that is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex I
full_text: ‘qualified certificate for electronic signature’ means a certificate for electronic signatures, that is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex I;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic service normally provided for remuneration which consists of: (a) the creation, verification, and validation of electronic signatures, electronic seals or electronic time stamps, electronic registered delivery services and certificates related to those services, or (b) the creation, verification and validation of certificates for website authentication; or (c) the preservation of electronic signatures, seals or certificates related to those services
full_text: ‘trust service’ means an electronic service normally provided for remuneration which consists of: (a) the creation, verification, and validation of electronic signatures, electronic seals or electronic time stamps, electronic registered delivery services and certificates related to those services, or (b) the creation, verification and validation of certificates for website authentication; or (c) the preservation of electronic signatures, seals or certificates related to those services;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a trust service that meets the applicable requirements laid down in this Regulation
full_text: ‘qualified trust service’ means a trust service that meets the applicable requirements laid down in this Regulation;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a body defined in point 13 of Article 2 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008, which is accredited in accordance with that Regulation as competent to carry out conformity assessment of a qualified trust service provider and the qualified trust services it provides
full_text: ‘conformity assessment body’ means a body defined in point 13 of Article 2 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008, which is accredited in accordance with that Regulation as competent to carry out conformity assessment of a qualified trust service provider and the qualified trust services it provides;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a natural or a legal person who provides one or more trust services either as a qualified or as a non-qualified trust service provider
full_text: ‘trust service provider’ means a natural or a legal person who provides one or more trust services either as a qualified or as a non-qualified trust service provider;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a trust service provider who provides one or more qualified trust services and is granted the qualified status by the supervisory body
full_text: ‘qualified trust service provider’ means a trust service provider who provides one or more qualified trust services and is granted the qualified status by the supervisory body;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: hardware or software, or relevant components of hardware or software, which are intended to be used for the provision of trust services
full_text: ‘product’ means hardware or software, or relevant components of hardware or software, which are intended to be used for the provision of trust services;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: configured software or hardware used to create an electronic signature
full_text: ‘electronic signature creation device’ means configured software or hardware used to create an electronic signature;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic signature creation device that meets the requirements laid down in Annex II
full_text: ‘qualified electronic signature creation device’ means an electronic signature creation device that meets the requirements laid down in Annex II;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a legal person who creates an electronic seal
full_text: ‘creator of a seal’ means a legal person who creates an electronic seal;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: data in electronic form, which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form to ensure the latter’s origin and integrity
full_text: ‘electronic seal’ means data in electronic form, which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form to ensure the latter’s origin and integrity;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic seal, which meets the requirements set out in Article 36
full_text: ‘advanced electronic seal’ means an electronic seal, which meets the requirements set out in Article 36;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an advanced electronic seal, which is created by a qualified electronic seal creation device, and that is based on a qualified certificate for electronic seal
full_text: ‘qualified electronic seal’ means an advanced electronic seal, which is created by a qualified electronic seal creation device, and that is based on a qualified certificate for electronic seal;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: unique data, which is used by the creator of the electronic seal to create an electronic seal
full_text: ‘electronic seal creation data’ means unique data, which is used by the creator of the electronic seal to create an electronic seal;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic attestation that links electronic seal validation data to a legal person and confirms the name of that person
full_text: ‘certificate for electronic seal’ means an electronic attestation that links electronic seal validation data to a legal person and confirms the name of that person;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a certificate for an electronic seal, that is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex III
full_text: ‘qualified certificate for electronic seal’ means a certificate for an electronic seal, that is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex III;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: configured software or hardware used to create an electronic seal
full_text: ‘electronic seal creation device’ means configured software or hardware used to create an electronic seal;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic seal creation device that meets mutatis mutandis the requirements laid down in Annex II
full_text: ‘qualified electronic seal creation device’ means an electronic seal creation device that meets mutatis mutandis the requirements laid down in Annex II;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: data in electronic form which binds other data in electronic form to a particular time establishing evidence that the latter data existed at that time
full_text: ‘electronic time stamp’ means data in electronic form which binds other data in electronic form to a particular time establishing evidence that the latter data existed at that time;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic time stamp which meets the requirements laid down in Article 42
full_text: ‘qualified electronic time stamp’ means an electronic time stamp which meets the requirements laid down in Article 42;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: any content stored in electronic form, in particular text or sound, visual or audiovisual recording
full_text: ‘electronic document’ means any content stored in electronic form, in particular text or sound, visual or audiovisual recording;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a service that makes it possible to transmit data between third parties by electronic means and provides evidence relating to the handling of the transmitted data, including proof of sending and receiving the data, and that protects transmitted data against the risk of loss, theft, damage or any unauthorised alterations
full_text: ‘electronic registered delivery service’ means a service that makes it possible to transmit data between third parties by electronic means and provides evidence relating to the handling of the transmitted data, including proof of sending and receiving the data, and that protects transmitted data against the risk of loss, theft, damage or any unauthorised alterations;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an electronic registered delivery service which meets the requirements laid down in Article 44
full_text: ‘qualified electronic registered delivery service’ means an electronic registered delivery service which meets the requirements laid down in Article 44;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: an attestation that makes it possible to authenticate a website and links the website to the natural or legal person to whom the certificate is issued
full_text: ‘certificate for website authentication’ means an attestation that makes it possible to authenticate a website and links the website to the natural or legal person to whom the certificate is issued;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: a certificate for website authentication, which is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex IV
full_text: ‘qualified certificate for website authentication’ means a certificate for website authentication, which is issued by a qualified trust service provider and meets the requirements laid down in Annex IV;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: data that is used to validate an electronic signature or an electronic seal
full_text: ‘validation data’ means data that is used to validate an electronic signature or an electronic seal;
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf

definition_text: the process of verifying and confirming that an electronic signature or a seal is valid
full_text: ‘validation’ means the process of verifying and confirming that an electronic signature or a seal is valid.
source_document: KB 2/Europe/eIDAS Regulation (Electronic Identification and Trust Services).pdf
